Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next asks — procurement gatekeepers and payment intent

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a few asks so we can line up the right commercial path: 

Call highlights (short):
- Use case: infra + inference for search ranking proofs-of-concept, scale to multi-tenant production H2.
- Primary constraint: predictable monthly spend and audit trail for usage (SaaS + some sensitive tenant data).
- Technical ask: SSO + SCIM in marketplace or direct (if Private deployment needed later).

Info we need to unblock procurement/legal: 
1) Which payment route do you prefer for initial POC and pilot (PO/net terms vs corporate card)? If PO, target terms (NET30/45)?
2) Is procurement open to purchasing via your cloud marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP)? If yes, procurement team will want marketplace terms + SSO requirements.
3) Who is the budget owner / economic buyer for this project? Who signs the PO vs who signs contracts (signatory)?
4) Any procurement docs we should complete or a questionnaire (SOC2, data residency, indemnity caps)?

I've attached a short MAAP-style worksheet with the procurement questions filled out in the sections we covered — feel free to drop in additional names/notes.

Proposed next steps:
- Sylvia/Jacob: confirm answers to items 1–3 above (1–2 bullets each).
- Redwood: we’ll prepare two pricing routes (card vs PO) and a one-page marketplace summary + initial commercial terms.
- Schedule: propose a 30-min follow-up with procurement + finance this week to align on payment path.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0189

From: Sylvia Chen <sylvia@harborcloud.com>

Cc: Jacob Miller <j.miller@harborcloud.com>, Daniel Brooks <dbrooks@harborcloud.com>, Laura Ng <laura.ng@harborcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next asks — procurement gatekeepers and payment intent

Marissa — thanks for the clear notes and the worksheet, that was helpful. Quick answers below (so we can move fast):

1) Payment route: Procurement prefers PO for any vendor expected to exceed $5k/month over the pilot window. For an initial short proof we can do card, but our target path for production is PO + NET30.

2) Marketplace: HarborCloud uses AWS Marketplace for procurement where possible; we are open to purchasing via marketplace but legal needs a marketplace-friendly T&C summary and confirmation on SSO/entitlement sync. Multi-account billing is a requirement for our infra teams.

3) Budget & approvals: 
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Daniel Brooks (CTO) — he owns compute budget for platform initiatives.
- Finance sponsor / billing contact: Jacob Miller — finance operations, handles PO intake and invoicing.
- Legal / signatory: Laura Ng (CFO) — signs contract value > $50k or multi-year commitments.

4) Security/compliance: We have a standard vendor security intake. SOC2 report is required for production; we will ask our security team for the questionnaire if needed.

Next steps from our side: I’ll loop in procurement@harborcloud.com if we need a formal PO template; happy to schedule a short sync with Daniel & Jacob this week.

Thanks —
Sylvia Chen
Head of Product Partnerships | HarborCloud
sylvia@harborcloud.com
